    "#  define CONFIG_EXAMPLES_EYE_CAM_MOUNTPOINT \"/mnt/sdcard\"\n"
    "#endif\n",
    "#ifndef CONFIG_EXAMPLES_EYE_CAM_MOUNTPOINT\n"
    "#  define CONFIG_EXAMPLES_EYE_CAM_MOUNTPOINT \"/mnt/sdcard\"\n"
    "#endif\n"
    "\n"
    "/* Dataset capture.  The crop the classifier is fed is written out at\n"
    " * full size, one BMP per frame, so the training images come off the\n"
    " * same rectangle, the same camera and the same expansion tables as the\n"
    " * inference does.  Rescaling to the model's tensor is left to the PC:\n"
    " * doing it here would mean a second resampler whose behaviour has to\n"
    " * be kept in step with PIL's.\n"
    " */\n"
    "\n"
    "#define EYE_CAM_CAP_DIR   CONFIG_EXAMPLES_EYE_CAM_MOUNTPOINT \"/eye_ds\"\n"
    "#define EYE_CAM_CAP_META  EYE_CAM_CAP_DIR \"/meta.txt\"\n"
    "#define EYE_CAM_CAP_DEF_N 220\n"
    "#define EYE_CAM_CAP_MAX_W 512     /* sanity bounds on a crop */\n"
    "#define EYE_CAM_CAP_MAX_H 512\n",
    "constants")

# ------------------------------------------------------------ 3. globals

sub("static int  g_tap_w = -1;\n"
    "static int  g_tap_h = -1;\n",
    "static int  g_tap_w = -1;\n"
    "static int  g_tap_h = -1;\n"
    "\n"
    "/* Capture state.  Zero frames means the app runs as it always did, so\n"
    " * nothing on the inference path changes when the mode is off.\n"
    " */\n"
    "\n"
    "static FAR const char *g_cap_label;   /* class name in the file name */\n"
    "static int             g_cap_count;   /* frames asked for            */\n"
    "static int             g_cap_saved;   /* frames written              */\n"
    "static int             g_cap_seq = 1; /* first free file number      */\n"
    "static FAR FILE       *g_cap_meta;    /* meta.txt, append            */\n",
    "globals")

# ---------------------------------------------------------- 4. functions

FUNCS = r'''/****************************************************************************
 * Name: eye_cam_cap_put_u16 / eye_cam_cap_put_u32
 *
 * Description:
 *   Little endian stores for the BMP header.  BMP is defined that way, so
 *   these stay even on a big endian build.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static void eye_cam_cap_put_u16(FAR uint8_t *p, uint16_t v)
{
  p[0] = (uint8_t)(v & 0xff);
  p[1] = (uint8_t)((v >> 8) & 0xff);
}

static void eye_cam_cap_put_u32(FAR uint8_t *p, uint32_t v)
{
  p[0] = (uint8_t)(v & 0xff);
  p[1] = (uint8_t)((v >> 8) & 0xff);
  p[2] = (uint8_t)((v >> 16) & 0xff);
  p[3] = (uint8_t)((v >> 24) & 0xff);
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: eye_cam_cap_header
 *
 * Description:
 *   Write the 14 byte file header and 40 byte DIB header of a 24bpp
 *   uncompressed BMP.  No palette: the images are colour.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static void eye_cam_cap_header(FAR FILE *fp, int w, int h, uint32_t imgsz)
{
  FAR uint8_t hdr[54];

  memset(hdr, 0, sizeof(hdr));

  hdr[0] = 'B';
  hdr[1] = 'M';
  eye_cam_cap_put_u32(&hdr[2], 54 + imgsz);       /* file size          */
  eye_cam_cap_put_u32(&hdr[10], 54);              /* pixel data offset  */
  eye_cam_cap_put_u32(&hdr[14], 40);              /* DIB header size    */
  eye_cam_cap_put_u32(&hdr[18], (uint32_t)w);
  eye_cam_cap_put_u32(&hdr[22], (uint32_t)h);
  eye_cam_cap_put_u16(&hdr[26], 1);               /* colour planes      */
  eye_cam_cap_put_u16(&hdr[28], 24);              /* bits per pixel     */
  eye_cam_cap_put_u32(&hdr[34], imgsz);
  eye_cam_cap_put_u32(&hdr[38], 2835);            /* 72 dpi             */
  eye_cam_cap_put_u32(&hdr[42], 2835);
  eye_cam_cap_put_u32(&hdr[46], 0);               /* no palette         */
  eye_cam_cap_put_u32(&hdr[50], 0);

  fwrite(hdr, 1, sizeof(hdr), fp);
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: eye_cam_cap_row
 *
 * Description:
 *   Convert one crop row out of the framebuffer, one output pixel per
 *   source pixel.  The crop follows the face, so near the edge of the
 *   frame it hangs over it: outside pixels are black, matching what the
 *   classifier's input gets from the same rectangle.
 *
 *   Channel expansion goes through g_exp5/g_exp6, the tables the input
 *   path uses, so a pixel means the same thing in a captured file and in
 *   a tensor.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static void eye_cam_cap_row(FAR const uint16_t *fb, uint32_t stride_px,
                            int rx, int ry, int rw, int y,
                            FAR uint8_t *row)
{
  int sy = ry + y;
  int x;

  if (sy < 0 || sy >= EYE_CAM_FRAME_H)
    {
      memset(row, 0, (size_t)rw * 3);
      return;
    }

  {
    FAR const uint16_t *srow = &fb[(size_t)sy * stride_px];

    for (x = 0; x < rw; x++)
      {
        int sx = rx + x;
        uint16_t px = 0;

        if (sx >= 0 && sx < EYE_CAM_FRAME_W)
          {
            px = srow[sx];
          }

        /* BMP pixel order is B, G, R */

        row[x * 3 + 0] = g_exp5[px & 0x1f];
        row[x * 3 + 1] = g_exp6[(px >> 5) & 0x3f];
        row[x * 3 + 2] = g_exp5[(px >> 11) & 0x1f];
      }
  }
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: eye_cam_cap_next_seq
 *
 * Description:
 *   First unused file number for a label.  Probing with fopen rather than
 *   scanning the directory keeps the FATFS work to one entry per frame
 *   already present, and means a second run of the same class adds to the
 *   set instead of overwriting it - a bad batch can be deleted and redone
 *   without touching the good frames.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static int eye_cam_cap_next_seq(FAR const char *label)
{
  char path[160];
  FAR FILE *fp;
  int n;

  for (n = 1; n < 10000; n++)
    {
      snprintf(path, sizeof(path), EYE_CAM_CAP_DIR "/%s_%04d.bmp",
               label, n);

      fp = fopen(path, "rb");
      if (fp == NULL)
        {
          return n;
        }

      fclose(fp);
    }

  return -1;
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: eye_cam_cap_save
 *
 * Description:
 *   Write one frame's crop.  The image is streamed a row at a time: a
 *   whole 288x139 colour image in RAM would be 120 KB of contiguous heap
 *   for nothing, since the row is all that changes between iterations.
 *
 *   Rows go out bottom up, which is how BMP stores them, and the pad bytes
 *   that bring a row up to a multiple of four are zeroed once rather than
 *   per row - they are the same bytes every time.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static int eye_cam_cap_save(FAR const char *label, int seq, uint32_t stride_px,
                            FAR const struct eye_cam_face_s *face,
                            FAR FILE *meta)
{
  char path[160];
  FAR uint8_t *row;
  FAR FILE *fp;
  int rw = g_crop_w;
  int rh = g_crop_h;
  int rowsz;
  int y;

  if (rw <= 0 || rh <= 0 ||
      rw > EYE_CAM_CAP_MAX_W || rh > EYE_CAM_CAP_MAX_H)
    {
      return -EINVAL;
    }

  rowsz = (rw * 3 + 3) & ~3;

  row = malloc((size_t)rowsz);
  if (row == NULL)
    {
      return -ENOMEM;
    }

  memset(row, 0, (size_t)rowsz);

  snprintf(path, sizeof(path), EYE_CAM_CAP_DIR "/%s_%04d.bmp", label, seq);

  fp = fopen(path, "wb");
  if (fp == NULL)
    {
      free(row);
      return -errno;
    }

  eye_cam_cap_header(fp, rw, rh, (uint32_t)rowsz * (uint32_t)rh);

  for (y = rh - 1; y >= 0; y--)
    {
      eye_cam_cap_row(g_fb, stride_px, g_crop_x, g_crop_y, rw, y, row);

      if (fwrite(row, 1, (size_t)rowsz, fp) != (size_t)rowsz)
        {
          break;
        }
    }

  fclose(fp);
  free(row);

  /* One line per frame, so a badly placed crop can be found and dropped
   * on the PC side without opening a single image.  Flushed each time:
   * the card is pulled at the end of a session and an unflushed tail
   * would lose exactly the frames that show where the box drifted.
   */

  if (meta != NULL)
    {
      fprintf(meta, "%s %04d %d %d %d %d %.3f %.1f %.1f %.1f\n",
              label, seq, g_crop_x, g_crop_y, rw, rh,
              (double)face->score, (double)face->ex, (double)face->ey,
              (double)face->dx);
      fflush(meta);
    }

  return 0;
}

## 固件

```
cmake_out/atk-dnn647_eye/nuttx.bin
md5 6adff21fadc54c1951cbb3e20bfc42fa   720,844 B   → 0x70100000
```

权重区不变（`eye-data.hex` 不用重刷，模型没动）。

## 用法

**先做一次小批量验证**（确认写盘正常、图是对的，再跑正式的）：

```
nsh> eye_cam capture test 5
```

检查 `/mnt/sdcard/eye_ds/` 下有没有 `test_0001..0005.bmp` 和 `meta.txt`。把卡插到 PC 上看一眼那 5 张图——**应该就是框里那双眼睛，没有青框、没有彩色框、没有瞳孔锚点**。

确认后按顺序跑五类：

```
nsh> eye_cam capture open 220
nsh> eye_cam capture left 220
nsh> eye_cam capture right 220
nsh> eye_cam capture closed 220
nsh> eye_cam capture other 220
```

每类约 **1.5 分钟**（220 张 × 约 390 ms），五类合计约 **8 分钟**。存储约 **80 MB**。

## 每类怎么演

| 类别 | 怎么做 |
|---|---|
| `open` | 正对镜头睁眼自然看 |
| `left` | 眼球转向你的左边（头可跟随） |
| `right` | 眼球转向你的右边 |
| `closed` | 闭眼 |
| `other` | 眯眼、半闭、翻白眼、低头抬起——**只要不是上面四种** |

**这次头可以动，距离也可以变** —— 这正是重采的价值。建议刻意覆盖：

- **多采几个距离**（近/中/远各占一些），模型才能学到尺度不变性
- **头缓慢平移/转动**，模拟真实使用
- **每类的 220 张要有变化**，不要 220 张一模一样——那样的数据学不到鲁棒特征

不过**别动太快**：人脸跟丢的帧会被跳过不采（`face 0.6` 阈值），动作太急只是浪费时间。

## 两个注意点

**① 卡必须是 FAT32。** 板级没开 `CONFIG_FS_EXFAT`。启动日志里如果有 `FATFS mount /mnt/sdcard failed` 就是格式不对。

**② `meta.txt` 每帧一行**，记录了这张图用的框、人脸分数、眼心、瞳距：

```
# label seq crop_x crop_y crop_w crop_h score eye_x eye_y dx
open 0001 436 176 226 109 0.923 369.2 209.9 112.9
```

PC 端靠它做两件事：**过滤掉定位可疑的帧**（不用逐张看 1100 张图），以及**验证采集时的几何分布**。所以这张卡拔下来时**整个 `eye_ds/` 目录都要拷**，别只拷 BMP。

采集点在 `eye_cam_roi_to_input` **之后**、overlay **之前**——青框是画在裁剪区边界上的，采在后面会把框线烤进数据文件，就是你之前担心的那个污染。

存的**不是** 128×64 的模型输入，而是**裁剪框的原始像素**（约 226×109，随距离变）。缩放到训练尺寸留给 PC——在板端再做一次重采样，就要维护第二个 resize 实现和 PIL 的一致性，那是自找的麻烦。

# Vertical stack at 3x, so the eye region is big enough to judge detail.

Z = 3
W = max(im.width for im in ims)
H = sum(im.height for im in ims) + 6 * (len(ims) - 1)

canvas = Image.new("RGB", (W * Z, H * Z), (40, 40, 40))
y = 0
for im in ims:
    big = im.resize((im.width * Z, im.height * Z), Image.NEAREST)
    canvas.paste(big, (0, y))
    y += im.height * Z + 6 * Z

canvas.save("test_montage.png")
print("montage: %dx%d -> test_montage.png" % (canvas.width, canvas.height))

"""Occlusion test on the five test captures.

Question: does the strip below the eyes - cheeks and nose - carry any signal
the model actually uses?  If masking it moves the output no more than masking
a featureless patch, the answer is no and the crop can be tightened.

Method: mask one region at a time with the image's own mean colour (a neutral
fill, so the mask cannot be read as "eye closed"), re-run the float model and
compare the class probabilities with the unmasked run.  The L1 distance
between the two probability vectors is the region's contribution.

A sanity check is built in: the middle band holds the eyes, so it must
dominate.  If it does not, the numbers below mean nothing.
"""
import glob

import numpy as np
import onnxruntime as ort
from PIL import Image

MODEL = ("../交付包_五分类产物_给Linux_2026-09-18/02_中间产物/blink.onnx")
CLASSES = ["closed", "open", "left", "right", "other"]

sess = ort.InferenceSession(MODEL, providers=["CPUExecutionProvider"])


def prep(img):
    """torchvision Resize((64,128)) + ToTensor + Normalize(0.5, 0.5).

    For a PIL input, torchvision's Resize delegates to PIL with BILINEAR,
    so this is the same resampling the training script used.  Note the
    argument order swap: torchvision takes (h, w), PIL takes (w, h).
    """
    im = img.convert("RGB").resize((128, 64), Image.BILINEAR)
    x = np.asarray(im, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
    x = (x - 0.5) / 0.5
    return np.transpose(x, (2, 0, 1))[None].astype(np.float32)


def run(img):
    logits = sess.run(None, {"input": prep(img)})[0][0]
    e = np.exp(logits - logits.max())
    return e / e.sum()


def mask(img, region):
    """Fill a region with the image mean.  Returns a new image."""
    a = np.asarray(img.convert("RGB")).astype(np.float32)
    h, w, _ = a.shape
    mean = a.reshape(-1, 3).mean(axis=0)

    if region == "none":
        return img.convert("RGB")

    if region == "top":                       # forehead, brows
        a[0:h // 3] = mean
    elif region == "mid":                     # the eyes
        a[h // 3:2 * h // 3] = mean
    elif region == "bot":                     # cheeks and nose
        a[2 * h // 3:] = mean
    elif region == "nostril":                 # the nose itself, tightly
        # Working from the picture: the nostrils sit in the lower middle,
        # roughly a quarter of the width either side of centre.
        y0, y1 = int(h * 0.60), int(h * 0.88)
        x0, x1 = int(w * 0.28), int(w * 0.72)
        a[y0:y1, x0:x1] = mean
    else:
        raise ValueError(region)

    return Image.fromarray(a.astype(np.uint8))


files = sorted(glob.glob("test_*.bmp"))
REGIONS = ["none", "top", "mid", "bot", "nostril"]

print("模型: %s" % MODEL.split("/")[-1])
print("类别顺序: %s" % CLASSES)
print()

deltas = {r: [] for r in REGIONS if r != "none"}
summary = {}

for f in files:
    img = Image.open(f).convert("RGB")
    base = run(img)
    print("── %s  (%dx%d)" % (f, img.width, img.height))
    print("   %-9s %s" % ("region", "  ".join("%7s" % c for c in CLASSES)))
    print("   %-9s %s  %s" % ("none",
                              "  ".join("%7.3f" % v for v in base),
                              "← 无遮挡"))

    for r in REGIONS:
        if r == "none":
            continue
        p = run(mask(img, r))
        d = float(np.abs(p - base).sum())
        deltas[r].append(d)
        summary.setdefault(r, []).append(p)
        print("   %-9s %s  Δ=%.3f" % (r, "  ".join("%7.3f" % v for v in p), d))
    print()

print("══ 5 张平均 ══")
print("%-10s %8s %8s" % ("遮挡区", "平均Δ", "判定"))
for r in ["mid", "top", "bot", "nostril"]:
    m = float(np.mean(deltas[r]))
    if r == "mid":
        verdict = "眼睛区（必须最大）" if m > 0.15 else "⚠️ 竟然不大，实验无效"
    elif m < 0.05:
        verdict = "几乎没有贡献"
    elif m < 0.15:
        verdict = "贡献很小"
    else:
        verdict = "有明显贡献"
    print("%-10s %8.3f %s" % (r, m, verdict))

"""Occlusion test, second pass - bands cut by what is actually in them.

The first pass used equal thirds, which is wrong for this framing: the crop
height is 0.967*dx while the eye is about 0.248*dx tall, so with the eye
centre at 0.307 the eyes occupy y = 0.183 .. 0.431.  The "top" third
therefore contained the upper half of the eyes, which is why it scored
highest - not because the forehead matters.

Bands here follow the content:
    forehead  0.00 .. 0.18     above the eyes
    eyes      0.18 .. 0.43     the eyes themselves
    cheek     0.43 .. 0.66     below the eyes, above the nose
    nose      0.66 .. 1.00     the nostrils

Two fills are used.  The mean colour is neutral but forms a flat band; pure
black is a strong signal.  If a band's score depends heavily on which fill
was used, the number says more about the fill than about the band.
"""
import glob
import sys

import numpy as np
import onnxruntime as ort
from PIL import Image

_cands = glob.glob("/home/leihann/SoftwarePackage/*/02_中间产物/blink.onnx")
assert _cands, "blink.onnx not found"
MODEL = _cands[0]
CLASSES = ["closed", "open", "left", "right", "other"]

BANDS = [
    ("forehead", 0.00, 0.18),
    ("eyes", 0.18, 0.43),
    ("cheek", 0.43, 0.66),
    ("nose", 0.66, 1.00),
]

sess = ort.InferenceSession(MODEL, providers=["CPUExecutionProvider"])


def prep(img):
    im = img.convert("RGB").resize((128, 64), Image.BILINEAR)
    x = np.asarray(im, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
    x = (x - 0.5) / 0.5
    return np.transpose(x, (2, 0, 1))[None].astype(np.float32)


def run(img):
    logits = sess.run(None, {"input": prep(img)})[0][0]
    e = np.exp(logits - logits.max())
    return e / e.sum()


def mask(img, lo, hi, fill):
    a = np.asarray(img.convert("RGB")).astype(np.float32)
    h = a.shape[0]
    y0 = int(round(h * lo))
    y1 = int(round(h * hi))
    if y1 <= y0:
        y1 = y0 + 1
    if fill == "mean":
        a[y0:y1] = a.reshape(-1, 3).mean(axis=0)
    else:
        a[y0:y1] = 0.0
    return Image.fromarray(a.astype(np.uint8))


files = sorted(glob.glob("test_*.bmp"))
print("模型: %s" % MODEL.split("/")[-1])
print("图: %d 张 test_" % len(files))
print()
print("分带依据: crop_h = 0.967*dx, 眼高约 0.248*dx, 眼心 0.307")
print("        -> 眼睛占 y = 0.183 .. 0.431")
print()

acc = {}
for fill in ("mean", "black"):
    for name, lo, hi in BANDS:
        acc[(fill, name)] = []

for f in files:
    img = Image.open(f).convert("RGB")
    base = run(img)
    print("── %s (%dx%d)  base=%s" % (
        f, img.width, img.height,
        " ".join("%s %.3f" % (c[:4], v) for c, v in zip(CLASSES, base))))
    for fill in ("mean", "black"):
        row = []
        for name, lo, hi in BANDS:
            p = run(mask(img, lo, hi, fill))
            d = float(np.abs(p - base).sum())
            acc[(fill, name)].append(d)
            row.append("%s=%.3f" % (name, d))
        print("   fill=%-6s %s" % (fill, "  ".join(row)))
    print()

print("══ %d 张平均 L1 距离 ══" % len(files))
print("%-10s %10s %10s %10s" % ("遮挡带", "mean填充", "black填充", "两者差"))
for name, lo, hi in BANDS:
    a = float(np.mean(acc[("mean", name)]))
    b = float(np.mean(acc[("black", name)]))
    print("%-10s %10.3f %10.3f %10.3f" % (name, a, b, abs(a - b)))

print()
print("══ 判据 ══")
ey = float(np.mean(acc[("mean", "eyes")]))
for name, lo, hi in BANDS:
    if name == "eyes":
        continue
    m = float(np.mean(acc[("mean", name)]))
    ratio = m / ey if ey > 0 else 0.0
    print("%-10s 相对眼睛区 %.0f%%  %s"
          % (name, ratio * 100,
             "影响很小" if ratio < 0.15 else
             "影响不大" if ratio < 0.35 else
             "影响明显" if ratio < 0.7 else "影响很大"))

  1. the delivery package  - what Windows produced
  2. the board source tree - what got copied in, plus the .nsblob port
  3. the linked firmware   - what the symbols and blobs actually are
  4. the flash image       - the hex that goes to the NOR

A model that is right in one layer and wrong in another fails silently on
the board, so all four get checked against the same expected values.
"""
import hashlib
import os
import re
import subprocess

ROOT = "/home/leihann/openvela"
PKG = ("/home/leihann/SoftwarePackage/"
       "交付包_眼睛量化v2产物_给Linux_2026-09-19")
TOOLS = ROOT + "/prebuilts/gcc/linux-x86_64/arm-none-eabi/bin"
ELF = ROOT + "/cmake_out/atk-dnn647_eye/nuttx"

WANT_RAW = "671b11c391766304dd1e1ab4b0d314b1"      # v21, this package
WANT_OLD = "571880ba8730a550335ba76455ffa442"      # v20, must be gone
WANT_ECB = "2451a5813cd5ea59e341bff9ee29b1fd"
WANT_BLOB_EYE = 175680
WANT_BLOB_FACE = 48176

fails = []


def md5(p):
    h = hashlib.md5()
    with open(p, "rb") as fh:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def line(tag, path, want=None, size=None):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        print("  MISSING  %s  (%s)" % (tag, path))
        fails.append(tag)
        return None
    m = md5(path)
    sz = os.path.getsize(path)
    mark = "ok "
    if want is not None and m != want:
        mark = "BAD"
        fails.append(tag)
    if size is not None and sz != size:
        mark = "BAD"
        fails.append(tag)
    print("  %s  %-28s %s  %d B" % (mark, tag, m[:16], sz))
    return m


print("=" * 72)
print("1. 交付包产物  (Windows 产出)")
print("=" * 72)
d = os.path.join(PKG, "01_模型产物")
line("network_atonbuf.raw", os.path.join(d, "network_atonbuf.xSPI2.raw"),
     WANT_RAW, 2899745)
line("network_ecblobs.h", os.path.join(d, "network_ecblobs.h"), WANT_ECB)
print("  --  network.c               %d B"
      % os.path.getsize(os.path.join(d, "network.c")))

print()
print("=" * 72)
print("2. 板端源码树  (拷进来之后 + .nsblob 移植)")
print("=" * 72)
t = os.path.join(ROOT, "nuttx/libs/ai_aton/models/eye")
line("network_atonbuf.raw", os.path.join(t, "network_atonbuf.xSPI2.raw"),
     WANT_RAW, 2899745)
line("network_ecblobs.h", os.path.join(t, "network_ecblobs.h"), WANT_ECB)

nc = os.path.join(t, "network.c")
pn = os.path.join(d, "network.c")
nlines = len(open(nc, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().splitlines())
plines = len(open(pn, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().splitlines())
print("  板端 network.c  %d 行 / 包内 %d 行  (差 %d)"
      % (nlines, plines, nlines - plines))

src = open(nc, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
for probe in ("aton_model_ecblobs_to_ns", "ECBLOB_RUNTIME_SECTION",
              "__attribute__((section(\".nsblob\")))"):
    n = src.count(probe)
    ok = n > 0
    print("  %s  移植标记 %-28s x%d" % ("ok " if ok else "BAD", probe, n))
    if not ok:
        fails.append("port:" + probe)

# The diff against the package must be exactly the port, nothing else.
diff = subprocess.run(["diff", pn, nc], capture_output=True, text=True)
added = sum(1 for l in diff.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith(">"))
removed = sum(1 for l in diff.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith("<"))
print("  %s  diff vs 包  +%d/-%d 行"
      % ("ok " if (added == 31 and removed == 0) else "BAD", added, removed))
if not (added == 31 and removed == 0):
    fails.append("network.c diff")

print()
print("=" * 72)
print("3. 链接后固件  (符号与 blob)")
print("=" * 72)
nm = subprocess.run([os.path.join(TOOLS, "arm-none-eabi-nm"), "-S", ELF],
                    capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
syms = {}
for ln in nm.splitlines():
    f = ln.split()
    if len(f) == 4:
        syms.setdefault(f[3], []).append((int(f[0], 16), int(f[1], 16)))

for name in ("aton_model_ecblobs_to_ns", "LL_ATON_EC_Network_Init_Default"):
    hit = syms.get(name)
    print("  %s  %-34s %s" % ("ok " if hit else "BAD", name, hit or "MISSING"))
    if not hit:
        fails.append(name)

blobs = sorted(syms.get("_ec_blob_1", []))
print("  _ec_blob_1 找到了 %d 个:" % len(blobs))
want = [WANT_BLOB_EYE, WANT_BLOB_FACE]
got = sorted(s for _, s in blobs)
print("     实际大小 %s  (期望 %s)  %s"
      % (got, sorted(want), "ok" if got == sorted(want) else "BAD"))
if got != sorted(want):
    fails.append("blob sizes")

print()
print("=" * 72)
print("4. 权重烧写镜像")
print("=" * 72)
hexp = "/home/leihann/SoftwarePackage/eye_flash/eye-data.hex"
binp = "/home/leihann/SoftwarePackage/eye_flash/eye_model_data.xSPI2.bin"
line("eye_model_data.xSPI2.bin", binp, WANT_RAW)
with open(hexp) as fh:
    head = fh.readline().strip()
    fh.seek(0)
    tail = fh.read().splitlines()[-2:]
print("  hex 首行  %s   %s" % (head, "ok" if head == ":0200000470404A" else "BAD"))
print("  hex 末两行 %s   %s"
      % (tail, "ok" if tail == [":040000057040000047", ":00000001FF"] else "BAD"))
if head != ":0200000470404A":
    fails.append("hex head")

print()
print("=" * 72)
print("5. 旧模型是否已彻底不在")
print("=" * 72)
for tag, path in [("板端 raw", os.path.join(t, "network_atonbuf.xSPI2.raw")),
                  ("烧写 bin", binp)]:
    m = md5(path)
    print("  %s  %-12s %s   %s"
          % ("ok " if m != WANT_OLD else "BAD", tag, m[:16],
             "（不是 v20）" if m != WANT_OLD else "（还是 v20！）"))
    if m == WANT_OLD:
        fails.append("old model still at " + tag)

print()
print("=" * 72)
if fails:
    print("❌ 检查未通过：%s" % fails)
else:
    print("✅ 全部通过 —— 四层一致，v2 模型 + .nsblob 移植都在")
print("=" * 72)

"""Verify the new framing with the occlusion test.

Frames 11-15 were captured with the bottom edge raised a quarter, so the
nostrils should now be outside the crop.  Bands are cut from each frame's
own detected eye position rather than assuming a fixed layout, so they
follow the subject.

What to look for: "below" should now score far lower than it did on the old
framing (where it was 20% of the eyes), because what is left down there is
cheek and glasses frame, not nose.
"""
import glob

import numpy as np
import onnxruntime as ort
from PIL import Image

_cands = glob.glob("/home/leihann/SoftwarePackage/*/02_中间产物/blink.onnx")
assert _cands, "blink.onnx not found"
MODEL = _cands[0]
CLASSES = ["closed", "open", "left", "right", "other"]

FILES = ["test_%04d.bmp" % i for i in range(11, 16)]
EYE_HALF = 0.175          # half the eye height, as a fraction of crop height

rel = {}
for line in open("meta.txt", encoding="utf-8"):
    if not line.startswith("test"):
        continue
    p = line.split()
    seq = int(p[1])
    if seq >= 11:
        rel[seq] = (float(p[8]) - float(p[3])) / float(p[5])

sess = ort.InferenceSession(MODEL, providers=["CPUExecutionProvider"])


def prep(img):
    im = img.convert("RGB").resize((128, 64), Image.BILINEAR)
    x = np.asarray(im, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
    return np.transpose((x - 0.5) / 0.5, (2, 0, 1))[None].astype(np.float32)


def run(img):
    z = sess.run(None, {"input": prep(img)})[0][0]
    e = np.exp(z - z.max())
    return e / e.sum()


def mask(img, lo, hi):
    a = np.asarray(img.convert("RGB")).astype(np.float32)
    h = a.shape[0]
    y0 = int(round(h * max(0.0, lo)))
    y1 = int(round(h * min(1.0, hi)))
    if y1 <= y0:
        y1 = y0 + 1
    a[y0:y1] = a.reshape(-1, 3).mean(axis=0)
    return Image.fromarray(a.astype(np.uint8))


print("模型: %s" % MODEL.split("/")[-1])
print("新构图（下界上推 1/4）：test_0011..0015")
print()

acc = {"forehead": [], "eyes": [], "below": []}
for f in FILES:
    seq = int(f[5:9])
    e = rel.get(seq, 0.413)
    img = Image.open(f).convert("RGB")
    base = run(img)

    parts = []
    for name, lo, hi in [("forehead", 0.0, e - EYE_HALF),
                         ("eyes", e - EYE_HALF, e + EYE_HALF),
                         ("below", e + EYE_HALF, 1.0)]:
        d = float(np.abs(run(mask(img, lo, hi)) - base).sum())
        acc[name].append(d)
        parts.append("%s=%.3f" % (name, d))

    print("  %s  eye_rel=%.3f  带 %.0f..%.0f%%"
          % (f, e, (e - EYE_HALF) * 100, (e + EYE_HALF) * 100))
    print("      %s" % "  ".join(parts))
    print("      base  %s" % " ".join("%s %.3f" % (c[:4], v)
                                      for c, v in zip(CLASSES, base)))

print()
print("══ 平均 L1 ══")
ey = float(np.mean(acc["eyes"]))
for name in ("eyes", "forehead", "below"):
    m = float(np.mean(acc[name]))
    note = "(基准)" if name == "eyes" else "相对眼睛区 %.0f%%" % (m / ey * 100)
    print("  %-10s %.3f   %s" % (name, m, note))

print()
print("══ 与旧构图对照（occlusion_test2.py 的同一模型）══")
print("  旧: eye_rel 0.31，下方含鼻孔，'nose' 区 = 0.375 = 眼睛区的 20%")
print("  新: 见上，'below' 区应显著更低")

"""Occlusion, both framings, same method - so the numbers can be compared.

The earlier passes cannot be compared with each other: one used equal
thirds, another used bands derived from the eye position.  Here both the
old frames (1-5, eye_rel 0.31) and the new ones (11-15, eye_rel 0.414) are
cut with bands derived from their own detected eye position.

Prints what the model decides after each mask, not just the distance: a
large delta that keeps the same top class means something different from a
small delta that flips it.
"""
import glob

import numpy as np
import onnxruntime as ort
from PIL import Image

_cands = glob.glob("/home/leihann/SoftwarePackage/*/02_中间产物/blink.onnx")
assert _cands, "blink.onnx not found"
MODEL = _cands[0]
CLASSES = ["closed", "open", "left", "right", "other"]

EYE_HALF = 0.175          # half the eye height, as a fraction of crop height

GROUPS = [("old 0001-0005 (eye_rel 0.31)", [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]),
          ("new 0011-0015 (eye_rel 0.414)", [11, 12, 13, 14, 15])]

rel = {}
for line in open("meta.txt", encoding="utf-8"):
    if not line.startswith("test"):
        continue
    p = line.split()
    rel[int(p[1])] = (float(p[8]) - float(p[3])) / float(p[5])

sess = ort.InferenceSession(MODEL, providers=["CPUExecutionProvider"])


def prep(img):
    im = img.convert("RGB").resize((128, 64), Image.BILINEAR)
    x = np.asarray(im, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
    return np.transpose((x - 0.5) / 0.5, (2, 0, 1))[None].astype(np.float32)


def run(img):
    z = sess.run(None, {"input": prep(img)})[0][0]
    e = np.exp(z - z.max())
    return e / e.sum()


def mask(img, lo, hi):
    a = np.asarray(img.convert("RGB")).astype(np.float32)
    h = a.shape[0]
    y0 = int(round(h * max(0.0, lo)))
    y1 = int(round(h * min(1.0, hi)))
    if y1 <= y0:
        y1 = y0 + 1
    a[y0:y1] = a.reshape(-1, 3).mean(axis=0)
    return Image.fromarray(a.astype(np.uint8))


def top(p):
    i = int(p.argmax())
    return "%s %.2f" % (CLASSES[i][:5], p[i])


print("模型: %s" % MODEL.split("/")[-1])
print()

for title, seqs in GROUPS:
    print("══ %s ══" % title)
    acc = {"eyes": [], "forehead": [], "below": []}
    for s in seqs:
        f = "test_%04d.bmp" % s
        e = rel[s]
        img = Image.open(f).convert("RGB")
        base = run(img)

        parts = []
        for name, lo, hi in [("forehead", 0.0, e - EYE_HALF),
                             ("eyes", e - EYE_HALF, e + EYE_HALF),
                             ("below", e + EYE_HALF, 1.0)]:
            p = run(mask(img, lo, hi))
            d = float(np.abs(p - base).sum())
            acc[name].append(d)
            parts.append("%-8s Δ=%.3f -> %s" % (name, d, top(p)))

        print("  %s  h=%d  eye_rel=%.3f  base=%s"
              % (f, img.height, e, top(base)))
        for t in parts:
            print("      %s" % t)

    ey = float(np.mean(acc["eyes"]))
    print("  ── 平均: eyes=%.3f  forehead=%.3f (%.0f%%)  below=%.3f (%.0f%%)"
          % (ey,
             float(np.mean(acc["forehead"])),
             float(np.mean(acc["forehead"])) / ey * 100,
             float(np.mean(acc["below"])),
             float(np.mean(acc["below"])) / ey * 100))
    print()

| 构图 | 遮眼睛带 | 遮眼睛**下方** | 遮后判决 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 旧 eye_rel 0.31（含鼻孔） | Δ=1.147 | **Δ=1.510 (132%)** | **4/5 翻成 left** |
| 新 eye_rel 0.414（鼻孔出框） | Δ=0.742 | **Δ=0.388 (52%)** | **0/5 翻** |

⇒ **旧构图的眼睛下方（脸颊+鼻孔）被模型当成"这是 open"的证据**（shortcut learning）。
真实场景里那块区域稍变（距离/光照/头姿），支持就塌、left 冒出来 ——
这就是"open 容易被判成 left"的机制。裁掉是对的。

⚠️ **不要误读**：新构图下遮眼睛带，4/5 张仍判 open（只 0011 翻 close）。
那是**旧模型没见过新构图**（它练的是固定 ROI，eye_rel 0.59）的表现。
重训后必须用**新模型**复验，届时 eyes 区 Δ 应回到主导。

## 裁剪参数（本次改的）
- 新增 `EYE_CAM_CROP_H_SCALE = 0.75f`：`crop_h = crop_w × 145/300 × 0.75`
- `EYE_CAM_CROP_EYE_REL` **0.31 → 0.413**（= 0.31/0.75，**锁定上界不动**）
  —— 只改 crop_h 会让 crop_y 下移，必须同步改 rel 才能保住上界
- 依据：鼻区贡献仅眼睛区 20%、上方区仅 1%，而 cheek（眼下方 43-66%）77% **必须保留**
- 效果（dx=100）：crop 200×97 → **200×73**，眼位 0.307→0.413，crop_y 严格不变（211）

## 采集质量已验（0011-0015）
尺寸 193×70 等随 dx 浮动；`eye_rel` 实测 0.406~0.420 平均 **0.414**（设计 0.413 ✅）；
`crop_y = eye_y - 0.413×crop_h` 与 meta 逐项吻合；鼻孔已出框；画质清晰无污染。

## 采集模式（同一固件）
`eye_cam capture <label> [count]`，每类单独跑、采满即 break 退出。
- 采集点夹在 `roi_to_input` 之后、**overlay 之前**（青框画在裁剪区边界，之后采会烤进图）
- 只在 `face_ok && g_crop_ok` 时采（沿用上帧的框不采 —— 框不对的图比缺图更糟）
- 1:1 原始像素、24bpp BMP、越界填黑、通道走 `g_exp5/g_exp6`

- ⚠️ 没有 `CONFIG_FS_EXFAT`，**卡必须 FAT32**

采五类各 220 张（`open`/`left`/`right`/`closed`/`other`）→ 写训练脚本 → 重训
→ **用新模型复验遮挡实验** → 量化 → 落板

## ⚠️ 产物验证的坑
float 常量**不一定在数据段**：ARMv8-M 的 `vmov.f32 sN, #imm` 把 0.5/0.75/1.0/2.0
这类"好数"编码进**指令**（如 `#104 @ 0x3f400000`）。二进制搜 `0.75` 得 count=0
**不代表没生效**。判据：
- 非好数（如 0.413）→ 走 literal pool，能搜到
- 好数 → 反汇编找 `vmov.f32` + `vfma`（`vfma s13,s11,s12` = `s11×0.75+s13`）

  1. geometry from meta.txt - distance outliers, eye placement drift
  2. image statistics - exposure and focus

     are worth a look, though remember the model predates this framing.

def verdict(img):

lowsc = [(r["seq"], r["score"]) for r in rows if r["score"] < 0.90]

print()

# ---- image statistics -----------------------------------------------------
stats = []
for seq in sorted(files):
    a = np.asarray(Image.open(files[seq]).convert("L"), dtype=np.float32)
    gx = np.abs(np.diff(a, axis=1)).mean()

"""Audit a capture directory for problems that are not obvious by eye.

    python3 audit.py <dir>

<dir> must hold the images and the meta.txt the board wrote.  The label is
taken from meta.txt, so the same script works for every class.

Passes:
  0. what is in the directory - labels, counts, stray files
  1. meta vs disk      - records and files that do not pair up
  2. geometry          - distance spread, eye placement drift
  3. image statistics  - exposure and focus
  4. model verdicts    - frames the float model reads differently

On pass 4: the model predates this framing (it was trained on the fixed ROI
at eye_rel 0.59, these crops are at 0.413), so its absolute verdicts are not
a pass/fail test.  The outlier pattern is the useful part - a few frames it
reads unlike the rest deserve a look whatever the cause.
"""
import glob
import os
import statistics
import sys

import numpy as np
import onnxruntime as ort
from PIL import Image

DIR = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "."
os.chdir(DIR)

MODEL = glob.glob("/home/leihann/SoftwarePackage/*/02_中间产物/blink.onnx")[0]
CLASSES = ["closed", "open", "left", "right", "other"]
sess = ort.InferenceSession(MODEL, providers=["CPUExecutionProvider"])


def prep(img):
    im = img.convert("RGB").resize((128, 64), Image.BILINEAR)
    x = np.asarray(im, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
    return np.transpose((x - 0.5) / 0.5, (2, 0, 1))[None].astype(np.float32)


def verdict(img):
    z = sess.run(None, {"input": prep(img)})[0][0]
    e = np.exp(z - z.max())
    p = e / e.sum()
    return int(p.argmax()), float(p.max())


raw = []
for line in open("meta.txt", encoding="utf-8"):
    if line.startswith("#") or not line.strip():
        continue
    p = line.split()
    raw.append(dict(label=p[0], seq=int(p[1]), cy=int(p[3]), w=int(p[4]),
                    h=int(p[5]), score=float(p[6]), ey=float(p[8]),
                    dx=float(p[9])))

print("== 0. 目录 %s ==" % os.path.basename(os.path.abspath(DIR)))
print("   meta labels: %s" % sorted({r["label"] for r in raw}))
stray = [f for f in os.listdir(".")
         if not f.endswith(".bmp") and f != "meta.txt"
         and not f.endswith(".py") and not f.endswith(".png")]
print("   其他文件: %s" % (stray if stray else "无"))

for LABEL in sorted({r["label"] for r in raw}):
    rows = [r for r in raw if r["label"] == LABEL]
    pre = LABEL + "_"
    files = {}
    for f in glob.glob(pre + "*.bmp"):
        try:
            files[int(f[len(pre):len(pre) + 4])] = f
        except ValueError:
            pass
    if not files:
        continue

    print()
    print("── '%s'  meta %d 条 / 磁盘 %d 个 ──" % (LABEL, len(rows), len(files)))

    got = set(files)
    onlymeta = sorted({r["seq"] for r in rows} - got)
    onlyfile = sorted(got - {r["seq"] for r in rows})
    print("   仅 meta（文件已删）: %d %s"
          % (len(onlymeta), onlymeta[:8] if onlymeta else ""))
    print("   仅文件（meta 无）  : %s" % (onlyfile[:8] if onlyfile else "无"))

    kept = [r for r in rows if r["seq"] in got]
    if not kept:
        continue

    dxs = [r["dx"] for r in kept]
    q = statistics.quantiles(dxs, n=4)
    print("   dx    %.1f .. %.1f  中位 %.1f  IQR %.1f..%.1f"
          % (min(dxs), max(dxs), statistics.median(dxs), q[0], q[2]))
    print("      最近5 %s" % ", ".join("%04d(%.0f)" % (r["seq"], r["dx"])
                                       for r in sorted(kept, key=lambda r: r["dx"])[:5]))
    print("      最远5 %s" % ", ".join("%04d(%.0f)" % (r["seq"], r["dx"])
                                       for r in sorted(kept, key=lambda r: -r["dx"])[:5]))

    rels = [(r["ey"] - r["cy"]) / r["h"] for r in kept]
    print("   eye_rel %.3f .. %.3f  中位 %.3f  (设计 0.413)"
          % (min(rels), max(rels), statistics.median(rels)))
    bad = [(r["seq"], round((r["ey"] - r["cy"]) / r["h"], 3)) for r in kept
           if abs((r["ey"] - r["cy"]) / r["h"] - 0.413) > 0.06]
    print("      偏离>0.06: %s" % (bad[:8] if bad else "无"))

    scs = [r["score"] for r in kept]
    print("   score %.3f .. %.3f  中位 %.3f" % (min(scs), max(scs), statistics.median(scs)))
    lows = [(r["seq"], r["score"]) for r in kept if r["score"] < 0.85]
    print("      <0.85 的 %d 张: %s" % (len(lows), lows[:8] if lows else "无"))

    if onlymeta:
        g = [r for r in rows if r["seq"] not in got]
        print("   [已删 %d 张的特征] score %.3f..%.3f  dx %.1f..%.1f"
              % (len(g), min(x["score"] for x in g), max(x["score"] for x in g),
                 min(x["dx"] for x in g), max(x["dx"] for x in g)))

    st = []
    for seq in sorted(files):
        a = np.asarray(Image.open(files[seq]).convert("L"), dtype=np.float32)
        st.append((seq, float(a.mean()), float(a.std()),
                   float(np.abs(np.diff(a, axis=1)).mean() +
                         np.abs(np.diff(a, axis=0)).mean())))
    for name, i in (("亮度", 1), ("对比度", 2), ("梯度", 3)):
        v = [s[i] for s in st]
        print("   %-4s %.1f .. %.1f  中位 %.1f" % (name, min(v), max(v),
                                                   statistics.median(v)))
    print("      最暗5 %s" % ", ".join("%04d(%.0f)" % (s[0], s[1])
                                       for s in sorted(st, key=lambda s: s[1])[:5]))
    print("      最糊5 %s" % ", ".join("%04d(%.2f)" % (s[0], s[3])
                                       for s in sorted(st, key=lambda s: s[3])[:5]))

    cnt = {}
    odd = []
    for seq in sorted(files):
        v, c = verdict(Image.open(files[seq]).convert("RGB"))
        cnt[CLASSES[v]] = cnt.get(CLASSES[v], 0) + 1
        if CLASSES[v] != LABEL:
            odd.append((seq, CLASSES[v], c))
    print("   旧模型判决: %s" % cnt)
    print("      非 '%s' 的 %d 张: %s"
          % (LABEL, len(odd), ", ".join("%04d->%s@%.2f" % o for o in odd[:12])))

"""Left captures: did the head turn, and did the eyes turn with it?

A left/right classifier should key on the iris position inside the eye - the
pale sclera wedge on one side.  If the head turned instead, the eyes may
barely have rotated and the wedge is not what the picture shows; worse, a
model trained on such frames learns head yaw, which fails the moment the
user keeps their head still and moves only the eyes.

The open-class frame at the end is the reference: head square to the camera.
"""
import os

from PIL import Image

CWD = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
REF = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(CWD, "..", "open", "open_0001.bmp"))

PICK = [
    ("left_0001.bmp", "判 open@1.00"),
    ("left_0002.bmp", "判 open@0.99"),
    ("left_0010.bmp", "判 open@1.00"),
    ("left_0020.bmp", "判 open"),
    ("left_0044.bmp", "判 closed@0.77"),
    ("left_0094.bmp", "判 closed@0.87"),
    (REF,             "对照 open 类(头正)"),
]

pick = [(f, t) for f, t in PICK if os.path.exists(f)]
ims = [Image.open(f).convert("RGB") for f, _ in pick]

Z = 3
W = max(i.width for i in ims)
H = sum(i.height for i in ims) + 6 * (len(ims) - 1)

c = Image.new("RGB", (W * Z, H * Z), (40, 40, 40))
y = 0
for (f, t), im in zip(pick, ims):
    c.paste(im.resize((im.width * Z, im.height * Z), Image.NEAREST), (0, y))
    y += im.height * Z + 6 * Z
    print("  %-18s %-20s %dx%d" % (os.path.basename(f), t, im.width, im.height))

c.save("check_head_yaw.png")
print("  -> check_head_yaw.png %dx%d" % c.size)

"""Estimate head yaw from where the nose bridge sits.

The crop is centred on the pupil midpoint, so with the head square the nose
bridge should sit near the middle of the frame.  A yawed head moves it to
one side.  Crude, but it separates "head a bit off" from "head square on"

Measures the darkest column in the lower half, where the bridge is, and
reports its offset from centre as a fraction of width.  The open class is
printed alongside as the reference - those were shot face-on.

import glob
import statistics

    dark = lower.mean(axis=0)              # per column

    k = max(3, w // 20)
    sm = np.convolve(dark, np.ones(k) / k, mode="same")
    x = int(sm.argmin())
    return (x - (w - 1) / 2.0) / w         # -0.5 .. +0.5

    print("           最偏 5: %s" % "  ".join("%s(%+.2f)" % (f.split("/")[-1][5:9], o)

"""Estimate head yaw from where the nose bridge sits in the frame.

The crop is centred on the pupil midpoint, so with the head square to the
camera the bridge sits near the middle of the frame; a yawed head pushes it
to one side.  Crude, but it separates "head a bit off" from "head square on"
well enough to judge usability.

Measures the darkest column of the lower half - below the eyes, where the
bridge and its shadow are - and reports the offset from centre as a fraction
of width.  The open class is measured alongside as the reference: those were
shot facing the camera.

Note the sign is arbitrary (depends on where the shadow falls), so read the
spread, not the sign.
"""
import glob
import statistics

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image


def bridge_offset(path):
    a = np.asarray(Image.open(path).convert("L"), dtype=np.float32)
    h, w = a.shape
    lower = a[int(h * 0.55):]
    col = lower.mean(axis=0)
    k = max(3, w // 20)
    sm = np.convolve(col, np.ones(k) / k, mode="same")
    x = int(sm.argmin())
    return (x - (w - 1) / 2.0) / w


for name, pat in (("left", "left_*.bmp"),
                  ("open 对照", "../open/open_*.bmp"),
                  ("closed 对照", "../close/closed_*.bmp")):
    fs = sorted(glob.glob(pat))
    if not fs:
        continue
    offs = [(f, bridge_offset(f)) for f in fs]
    v = [o for _, o in offs]
    print("%-12s n=%3d   中位 %+.3f   均值 %+.3f   范围 %+.3f .. %+.3f   |中位| %.3f"
          % (name, len(v), statistics.median(v), statistics.fmean(v),
             min(v), max(v), abs(statistics.median(v))))
    ext = sorted(offs, key=lambda t: -abs(t[1]))[:5]
    print("             最偏 5: %s"
          % "  ".join("%s(%+.2f)" % (f.split("/")[-1][5:9], o) for f, o in ext))

"""Average face: stack many captures to see the framing they share.

Averaging removes lighting, glasses glare and frame-to-frame variation,
leaving what the captures have in common.  If the head was yawed while
shooting the left class, the average nose bridge will sit off the average
eye centre - and the open class, shot face-on, gives the baseline to compare
against.

The columns to the far left and right are ignored when locating the bridge:
those are cheek and frame edge, which are darker than the bridge and would
win the argmin otherwise.
"""
import glob

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

SZ = (192, 72)          # w, h - common canvas
EDGE = 0.12             # fraction of width to ignore at each side


def average(pat, n=250):
    fs = sorted(glob.glob(pat))[:n]
    acc = None
    for f in fs:
        a = np.asarray(Image.open(f).convert("L").resize(SZ, Image.BILINEAR),
                       dtype=np.float32)
        acc = a if acc is None else acc + a
    return acc / len(fs)


def bridge(m):
    h, w = m.shape
    lo = m[int(h * 0.55):]
    col = lo.mean(axis=0)
    i0, i1 = int(w * EDGE), int(w * (1 - EDGE))
    x = i0 + int(col[i0:i1].argmin())
    k = max(3, w // 20)
    sm = np.convolve(col, np.ones(k) / k, mode="same")
    xs = i0 + int(sm[i0:i1].argmin())
    return (x - (w - 1) / 2.0) / w, (xs - (w - 1) / 2.0) / w, m


tiles = []
for name, pat in (("left", "left_*.bmp"),
                  ("open", "../open/open_*.bmp"),
                  ("closed", "../close/closed_*.bmp")):
    fs = glob.glob(pat)
    if not fs:
        continue
    m = average(pat)
    raw, smooth, _ = bridge(m)
    print("%-8s n=%3d   鼻梁列偏移  原始 %+.3f   平滑 %+.3f"
          % (name, min(len(fs), 250), raw, smooth))
    tiles.append((name, m))

Z = 3
W = SZ[0]
H = SZ[1] * len(tiles) + 4 * (len(tiles) - 1)
c = Image.new("RGB", (W * Z, H * Z), (40, 40, 40))
y = 0
for name, m in tiles:
    im = Image.fromarray(m.astype(np.uint8)).convert("RGB")
    c.paste(im.resize((W * Z, SZ[1] * Z), Image.NEAREST), (0, y))
    y += SZ[1] * Z + 4 * Z
c.save("avg_faces.png")
print("  -> avg_faces.png %dx%d  (上到下: %s)"
      % (c.size[0], c.size[1], ", ".join(t[0] for t in tiles)))

"""Find the average face's axis of symmetry, using the region below the eyes.

The crop is centred on the pupil midpoint, so a face shot square to the
camera should be symmetric about the frame centre.  Sliding a vertical axis
across the average image and measuring how well the two halves match (one
mirrored) locates the real midline; its offset from centre is the yaw.

Only the area below the eyes is used.  The eyes themselves are asymmetric in
the left and right classes - that is the whole point of those classes - and
including them would drag the axis towards the iris, mistaking eye rotation
for head rotation.

The open class is the control: shot face-on, so its offset is the baseline
that left has to be compared against.
"""
import glob

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

SZ = (192, 72)
LOWER = 0.50            # use rows below this fraction of the height
SEARCH = (0.30, 0.70)   # where the midline may lie


def average(pat, n=250):
    fs = sorted(glob.glob(pat))[:n]
    acc = None
    for f in fs:
        a = np.asarray(Image.open(f).convert("L").resize(SZ, Image.BILINEAR),
                       dtype=np.float32)
        acc = a if acc is None else acc + a
    return acc / len(fs)


def symmetry_axis(m):
    h, w = m.shape
    lo = m[int(h * LOWER):]
    best, bx = 1e18, w // 2
    for x in range(int(w * SEARCH[0]), int(w * SEARCH[1])):
        half = min(x, w - 1 - x)
        if half < 18:
            continue
        left = lo[:, x - half:x][:, ::-1]
        right = lo[:, x:x + half]
        d = float(np.abs(left - right).mean())
        if d < best:
            best, bx = d, x
    return (bx - (w - 1) / 2.0) / w, best


print("对称轴偏移（正=中线偏右），仅用眼睛以下区域")
print()
base = None
for name, pat in (("open 对照", "../open/open_*.bmp"),
                  ("closed 对照", "../close/closed_*.bmp"),
                  ("left", "left_*.bmp")):
    fs = glob.glob(pat)
    if not fs:
        continue
    m = average(pat)
    off, err = symmetry_axis(m)
    print("  %-12s n=%3d   偏移 %+.4f   残差 %.3f"
          % (name, min(len(fs), 250), off, err))
    if name.startswith("open"):
        base = off

if base is not None:
    print()
    print("  以 open（头正）为基准：")
    for name, pat in (("closed", "../close/closed_*.bmp"), ("left", "left_*.bmp")):
        fs = glob.glob(pat)
        if not fs:
            continue
        off, _ = symmetry_axis(average(pat))
        print("    %-8s 相对 open %+.4f  (= %.1f%% 图宽)"
              % (name, off - base, (off - base) * 100))

"""Average the horizontal-gradient image and find its axis of symmetry.

Two fixes over the first attempt:

  * edges, not brightness - the lighting falls off to one side of the frame
    (a window is behind you, not a studio light), and that gradient is not
    symmetric, so fitting brightness alone just finds the lamp
  * a fixed-width comparison window - the first version used
    min(x, w-1-x), which shrinks near the edges and made those positions
    look artificially well matched, pinning the answer to the search bound

Only rows below the eyes go in, because the eyes are the asymmetric part in
the left and right classes.
"""
import glob

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

SZ = (192, 72)
LOWER = 0.50


def average_grad(pat, n=250):
    fs = sorted(glob.glob(pat))[:n]
    acc = None
    for f in fs:
        a = np.asarray(Image.open(f).convert("L").resize(SZ, Image.BILINEAR),
                       dtype=np.float32)
        g = np.abs(np.diff(a, axis=1))          # one column narrower
        acc = g if acc is None else acc + g
    return acc / len(fs)


def symmetry_axis(m):
    h, w = m.shape
    lo = m[int(h * LOWER):]
    half = w // 3
    cen = (w - 1) / 2.0
    best, bx = 1e18, int(cen)
    for x in range(half, w - half):
        left = lo[:, x - half:x][:, ::-1]
        right = lo[:, x:x + half]
        d = float(np.abs(left - right).mean())
        if d < best:
            best, bx = d, x
    return (bx - cen) / w, best, bx, w


print("对称轴偏移（正 = 中线偏右），梯度图 + 固定窗口")
print()
res = {}
for name, pat in (("open 对照", "../open/open_*.bmp"),
                  ("closed 对照", "../close/closed_*.bmp"),
                  ("left", "left_*.bmp")):
    fs = glob.glob(pat)
    if not fs:
        continue
    off, err, bx, w = symmetry_axis(average_grad(pat))
    res[name] = off
    print("  %-12s n=%3d   偏移 %+.4f   残差 %.3f   (轴在列 %d/%d)"
          % (name, min(len(fs), 250), off, err, bx, w))

print()
base = None
for k in res:
    if k.startswith("open"):
        base = res[k]
if base is not None:
    print("  以 open（头正）为基准：")
    for k in ("closed 对照", "left"):
        if k in res:
            d = res[k] - base
            print("    %-12s %+.4f   = %.1f%% 图宽   ≈ %.1f 度（按脸宽 ~1.6 倍图宽估）"
                  % (k, d, d * 100, abs(d) * 100 / 1.6))

"""Per-frame yaw estimate: is the head angle stuck, or does it wander?

This matters more than the average.  A class where every frame carries the
same head yaw teaches the model that angle - it will pass on these captures
and fail the moment someone holds their head still and only moves their
eyes, which is the actual use case.  A class where the yaw wanders forces
the model onto the iris instead.

Samples frames and reports the spread.  Single frames are noisier than the
averaged images (glasses, shadows), so read the spread, not each value.
"""
import glob
import random
import statistics

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

SZ = (192, 72)
LOWER = 0.50
N = 60


def yaw_of(path):
    a = np.asarray(Image.open(path).convert("L").resize(SZ, Image.BILINEAR),
                   dtype=np.float32)
    g = np.abs(np.diff(a, axis=1))
    lo = g[int(g.shape[0] * LOWER):]
    h, w = lo.shape
    half = w // 4
    cen = (w - 1) / 2.0
    best, bx = 1e18, int(cen)
    for x in range(half, w - half):
        left = lo[:, x - half:x][:, ::-1]
        right = lo[:, x:x + half]
        d = float(np.abs(left - right).mean())
        if d < best:
            best, bx = d, x
    return (bx - cen) / w


random.seed(42)
print("逐帧头偏估计（采样 %d 帧/类）" % N)
print()
for name, pat in (("open 对照", "../open/open_*.bmp"),
                  ("closed 对照", "../close/closed_*.bmp"),
                  ("left", "left_*.bmp")):
    fs = sorted(glob.glob(pat))
    if not fs:
        continue
    if len(fs) > N:
        fs = random.sample(fs, N)
    v = [yaw_of(f) for f in fs]
    print("  %-12s 中位 %+.4f  均值 %+.4f  标准差 %.4f  IQR %+.3f..%+.3f"
          % (name, statistics.median(v), statistics.fmean(v), statistics.stdev(v),
             statistics.quantiles(v, n=4)[0], statistics.quantiles(v, n=4)[2]))

## 头偏检查：**没有额外头偏**，三重证据

**证据 1 — 对称轴（平均脸，避开眼睛）**
```
open  对照（头正）+0.0785   ← 基准
closed 对照（头正）+0.0262

```
`left` 落在两个头正类**之间**，相对基准只差 **-1.6% 图宽（≈1°）**。而两个头正对照**彼此**就差了 **-5.2%（≈3.3°）**——**基准噪声是 left 信号的 3 倍**。

**证据 2 — 逐帧头姿的变化量**
```
open   标准差 0.0867
closed 标准差 0.0704
left   标准差 0.0797    ← 和头正类同一水平
```
如果 left 是"每帧都偏同一个角度"，标准差会异常小。实测**和头正类相当**，说明头姿是自然变化的。

"""Head-yaw check for capture classes, using the region below the eyes.

    python3 yaw_check.py left right ...

Two measurements per class:

  average face   stack every frame, take the horizontal-gradient image (edges
                 rather than brightness, so the lighting falloff does not
                 dominate), then slide a fixed-width vertical axis and find
                 where the two halves match best when one is mirrored.  The
                 crop is centred on the pupil midpoint, so a square-on face
                 puts that axis at the frame centre; the offset is the yaw.

  frame spread   the same per frame on a sample.  A class where every frame
                 carries the same yaw teaches the model that angle and fails
                 when someone holds still and only moves their eyes, so the
                 spread matters more than the mean.

Everything below 65% of the height only.  The eyes are the asymmetric part in
the left and right classes; including them drags the axis towards the iris and
turns eye rotation into apparent head rotation - which is exactly the mistake
this script exists to avoid.
"""
import glob
import os
import random
import statistics
import sys

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

SZ = (192, 72)
LOWER = 0.65
N_SAMPLE = 60


def avg_grad(fs, n=250):
    acc = None
    for f in fs[:n]:
        a = np.asarray(Image.open(f).convert("L").resize(SZ, Image.BILINEAR),
                       dtype=np.float32)
        g = np.abs(np.diff(a, axis=1))
        acc = g if acc is None else acc + g
    return acc / min(len(fs), n)


def axis_of(m, rows_from=0.0):
    h, w = m.shape
    lo = m[int(h * rows_from):]
    half = w // 3
    cen = (w - 1) / 2.0
    best, bx = 1e18, int(cen)
    for x in range(half, w - half):
        left = lo[:, x - half:x][:, ::-1]
        right = lo[:, x:x + half]
        d = float(np.abs(left - right).mean())
        if d < best:
            best, bx = d, x
    return (bx - cen) / w, best


def per_frame(f):
    a = np.asarray(Image.open(f).convert("L").resize(SZ, Image.BILINEAR),
                   dtype=np.float32)
    g = np.abs(np.diff(a, axis=1))
    return axis_of(g, rows_from=LOWER)[0]


random.seed(42)

def collect(d):
    fs = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(d, "*.bmp")))
    return [f for f in fs if os.path.basename(f).split("_")[0] in
            ("open", "closed", "left", "right", "other")]


print("== 平均图对称轴（正 = 中线偏右；仅眼睛以下，避开虹膜）==")
res = {}
for d in sys.argv[1:]:
    fs = collect(d)
    if not fs:
        print("  %-10s 无数据" % os.path.basename(d))
        continue
    off, err = axis_of(avg_grad(fs))
    res[os.path.basename(d)] = off
    print("  %-10s n=%3d   偏移 %+.4f   残差 %.3f" % (os.path.basename(d), len(fs), off, err))

base = None
for k in res:
    if k.startswith("open") or k.startswith("closed"):
        base = res[k]
        break
if base is not None:
    print()
    print("  以头正类为基准（取第一个 open/closed）:")
    for k, v in res.items():
        if k == "open" or k == "closed":
            continue
        print("    %-10s 相对 %+.4f  = %.1f%% 图宽" % (k, v - base, (v - base) * 100))

print()
print("== 逐帧头姿变化（采样 %d 帧）==" % N_SAMPLE)
for d in sys.argv[1:]:
    fs = collect(d)
    if not fs:
        continue
    if len(fs) > N_SAMPLE:
        fs = random.sample(fs, N_SAMPLE)
    v = [per_frame(f) for f in fs]
    print("  %-10s 中位 %+.4f  标准差 %.4f   IQR %+.3f..%+.3f"
          % (os.path.basename(d), statistics.median(v), statistics.stdev(v),
             statistics.quantiles(v, n=4)[0], statistics.quantiles(v, n=4)[2]))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fixed-frame capture, for the 'other' class.

The other class is meant to cover what the application sees when there is no
eye in view - a scene, a wall, a face turned away.  The detector rejects
every one of those, and the capture path only writes frames the detector
placed (a crop left over from an earlier frame does not describe the current
one), so none of them could be recorded at all.

This adds a mode that pins the crop instead of deriving it: centred, and at
the same size the face crops come out at, so the training set stays one
scale and the resize to the model's tensor does the same thing to every
class.

    eye_cam capture other 220 fixed          uses 190x70
    eye_cam capture other 220 fixed 150 56   any size, for other distances
"""
import hashlib
import sys

P = "apps/examples/eye_cam/eye_cam_main.c"
s = open(P, encoding="utf-8").read()
before = len(s)


def sub(anchor, new, tag):
    global s
    n = s.count(anchor)
    if n != 1:
        sys.exit("FAIL %s: anchor x%d" % (tag, n))
    s = s.replace(anchor, new, 1)
    print("  ok  %s" % tag)


# ------------------------------------------------------------ 1. constants

sub("#define EYE_CAM_CAP_DEF_N 220\n",
    "#define EYE_CAM_CAP_DEF_N 220\n"
    "\n"
    "/* Fixed-frame captures use the size a face crop comes out at around a\n"
    " * typical working distance (dx 95 -> 190x70), so every class lands on\n"
    " * the same scale once resized to the tensor.\n"
    " */\n"
    "\n"
    "#define EYE_CAM_CAP_FIXED_W 190\n"
    "#define EYE_CAM_CAP_FIXED_H 70\n",
    "constants")

# -------------------------------------------------------------- 2. state

sub("static FAR FILE       *g_cap_meta;    /* meta.txt, append            */\n",
    "static FAR FILE       *g_cap_meta;    /* meta.txt, append            */\n"
    "static int             g_cap_fixed;   /* pin the crop, skip the face */\n"
    "static int             g_cap_fixed_w = EYE_CAM_CAP_FIXED_W;\n"
    "static int             g_cap_fixed_h = EYE_CAM_CAP_FIXED_H;\n",
    "state")

# -------------------------------------------------------- 3. argument parse

sub("      g_cap_label = (argc > 2) ? argv[2] : \"sample\";\n"
    "      g_cap_count = (argc > 3) ? atoi(argv[3]) : EYE_CAM_CAP_DEF_N;\n"
    "    }\n",
    "      g_cap_label = (argc > 2) ? argv[2] : \"sample\";\n"
    "      g_cap_count = (argc > 3) ? atoi(argv[3]) : EYE_CAM_CAP_DEF_N;\n"
    "\n"
    "      /* Optional \"fixed [w h]\": for the class that is defined by\n"
    "       * having no face in it, where a detector-driven crop can never\n"
    "       * fire.\n"
    "       */\n"
    "\n"
    "      if (argc > 4 && strcmp(argv[4], \"fixed\") == 0)\n"
    "        {\n"
    "          g_cap_fixed = 1;\n"
    "\n"
    "          if (argc > 6)\n"
    "            {\n"
    "              g_cap_fixed_w = atoi(argv[5]);\n"
    "              g_cap_fixed_h = atoi(argv[6]);\n"
    "            }\n"
    "        }\n"
    "    }\n",
    "argument parse")

# ------------------------------------------------------ 4. pin the crop

sub("          eye_cam_stage_add(EYE_CAM_ST_FACE, clock_systime_ticks() - t0);\n"
    "        }\n"
    "\n"
    "      t0 = clock_systime_ticks();\n",
    "          eye_cam_stage_add(EYE_CAM_ST_FACE, clock_systime_ticks() - t0);\n"
    "        }\n"
    "\n"
    "      /* Fixed-frame mode pins the crop here, after the detector has had\n"
    "       * its turn, so this is what the rest of the frame uses.  The\n"
    "       * detector still runs - it costs little next to the inference and\n"
    "       * its output is what the console reports - but nothing depends on\n"
    "       * it having found anything.\n"
    "       */\n"
    "\n"
    "      if (g_cap_fixed)\n"

    "          g_crop_y = (EYE_CAM_FRAME_H - g_crop_h) / 2;\n"
    "          g_crop_ok = 1;\n"
    "        }\n"
    "\n"
    "      t0 = clock_systime_ticks();\n",

# ------------------------------------------------------ 5. capture gate

sub("      if (g_cap_count > 0 && g_cap_saved < g_cap_count &&\n"

    "capture gate")

# ---------------------------------------------------- 6. the comment above

sub("       * Only frames the detector actually placed are written - a crop\n"
    "       * left over from the previous frame does not describe this one,\n"
    "       * and a training image whose box is wrong is worse than a\n"
    "       * missing one.\n"
    "       */\n",
    "       * Only frames the detector actually placed are written - a crop\n"
    "       * left over from the previous frame does not describe this one,\n"
    "       * and a training image whose box is wrong is worse than a\n"

    "       *\n"
    "       * Fixed-frame mode is the exception: there the crop describes\n"
    "       * the frame by construction, and the detector finding nothing is\n"
    "       * the normal case rather than a failure.\n"
    "       */\n",
    "comment")

# ------------------------------------------------------- 7. startup notice

sub("          eye_cam_out(\"eye_cam: capture \\\"%s\\\" %d frames to %s, \"\n"
    "                      \"from %04d\\n\",\n"
    "                      g_cap_label, g_cap_count, EYE_CAM_CAP_DIR,\n"

## 用法

```
nsh> eye_cam capture other 220 fixed
```

**固定框默认 190×70，居中** —— 这个尺寸不是随便定的：人脸裁剪在典型工作距离（dx≈95）下正好是 190×70，所以两类图片 resize 到 128×64 时**尺度变换完全一致**，模型看到的眼睛大小不会被"类别"混淆。

距离不同可以自定义：

```
nsh> eye_cam capture other 220 fixed 150 56     ← 远一些
nsh> eye_cam capture other 220 fixed 230 85     ← 近一些
```

## 拍什么

固定框取的是**画面正中**那块，所以把你想拍的放进画面中央即可。建议覆盖这几类运行时真会遇到的场景：

| 场景 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **空场景** | 墙、天花板、桌面、对着窗外 |
| **有人但没有眼睛** | 拍远处的人、只拍到身体、背影 |
| **脸转开** | 侧后脑勺、低头看不到眼睛 |
| **遮挡** | 手/物品挡脸、镜头被挡住 |

**刻意多覆盖几种**——这是 `other` 类的价值所在：让模型在该输出 `other` 的时候真的输出 `other`，而不是靠"没人脸就不采信预测"来兜底。你原来的应用逻辑里，人脸检测失败时会沿用旧框继续推理，那正是最需要 `other` 类兜住的时刻。

## 两个细节

**① `meta.txt` 里这类图的 `score` 会是 `0.000`** —— 因为固定框模式下人脸结果结构体是清零的。真实检测分数都 >0.6，所以 **`score = 0` 就是固定框的标记**，训练脚本可以据此区分（不过这批不需要区分，都是 `other`）。

**② 人脸检测仍然在跑**（哪怕画面里没人）——纯粹因为跳过它的改动比保留它大，而它的耗时（~150 ms）相对推理可以忽略。它对结果没有任何影响。

"""Sample the other class across its extremes: dark, bright, flat, busy.

Unlike the other classes these are not eyes, so "quality" means coverage -
do the frames span what the application will actually see when no eye is in
view?  Look at what is in them rather than how sharp they are.
"""
import glob

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

st = []
for f in sorted(glob.glob("other_*.bmp")):
    a = np.asarray(Image.open(f).convert("L"), dtype=np.float32)
    g = float(np.abs(np.diff(a, axis=1)).mean() + np.abs(np.diff(a, axis=0)).mean())
    st.append((f, float(a.mean()), float(a.std()), g))

picks = []
picks += [(f, "最暗 %.0f" % m) for f, m, _, _ in sorted(st, key=lambda t: t[1])[:2]]
picks += [(f, "最亮 %.0f" % m) for f, m, _, _ in sorted(st, key=lambda t: -t[1])[:2]]
picks += [(f, "最平(对比度%.0f)" % s) for f, _, s, _ in sorted(st, key=lambda t: t[2])[:2]]
picks += [(f, "最糊 %.1f" % g) for f, _, _, g in sorted(st, key=lambda t: t[3])[:2]]
picks += [(f, "最清 %.1f" % g) for f, _, _, g in sorted(st, key=lambda t: -t[3])[:2]]

# de-dup, keep order
seen = set()
uniq = []
for f, t in picks:
    if f not in seen:
        seen.add(f)
        uniq.append((f, t))
picks = uniq

ims = [Image.open(f).convert("RGB") for f, _ in picks]
Z = 3
W = max(i.width for i in ims)
H = sum(i.height for i in ims) + 5 * (len(ims) - 1)

c = Image.new("RGB", (W * Z, H * Z), (40, 40, 40))
y = 0
for (f, t), im in zip(picks, ims):
    c.paste(im.resize((im.width * Z, im.height * Z), Image.NEAREST), (0, y))
    y += im.height * Z + 5 * Z
    print("  %-18s %-16s %dx%d" % (f, t, im.width, im.height))

c.save("check_other.png")
print("  -> check_other.png %dx%d" % c.size)
print()
print("  亮度中位 %.0f  对比度中位 %.0f  梯度中位 %.1f  (n=%d)"
      % (sorted(t[1] for t in st)[len(st) // 2],
         sorted(t[2] for t in st)[len(st) // 2],
         sorted(t[3] for t in st)[len(st) // 2], len(st)))

# 眼动五分类 v3 重训任务书（Windows）

日期：2026-09-19
数据：板端重新采集的 991 张裁剪图（**不是**旧的固定 ROI 数据）

---

## 0. 这次和上次的区别（先看这个）

| | v2（现用） | **v3（本次）** |
|---|---|---|
| 数据来源 | 固定 ROI 300×145 裁出 | **板端脸框裁剪，随脸移动** |
| 裁剪比例 | 2.069 | **2.759** |
| 图像尺寸 | 300×145 固定 | **约 190×70，随距离浮动** |
| 眼睛在图中位置 | 59%（偏下） | **41.3%** |
| 含鼻孔 | 是 | **否**（下界已上推 1/4） |
| 样本数 | 585 | **991** |

**训练脚本和网络结构完全不变**，只有数据变了。所以命令和上次几乎一样。

---

## 1. 数据准备

把 `eye_photo/` 整个目录拷到 Windows，放在 `train_blink.py` 同级。

```
eye_photo/
  open/    193 张  open_0001.bmp ... open_0220.bmp
  close/   208 张  closed_0001.bmp ...
  left/    196 张  left_0001.bmp ...
  right/   186 张  right_0001.bmp ...
  other/   208 张  other_0001.bmp ...（固定框拍的场景图）
  meta.txt         每帧的裁剪框/人脸分数/眼心/瞳距
```

**注意**：

- `close/` 目录里的文件前缀是 **`closed`**（目录名和前缀不一致，脚本按前缀匹配，能对上）
- 每个子目录里还有一个 `meta.txt`（板端原样带的），**不用管，脚本会忽略**
- 根目录若有 `test_*.bmp`，会被 `EXCLUDE_PREFIXES` 自动排除，**不用手动删**
- 类别顺序由 `eye_common.py` 固定为 `closed, open, left, right, other`，**与板端 `0/1/2/3/4` 一致，不要改**

**数据概况**（采集阶段已逐张审计过，几何与画质全部通过）：

| 类 | 张数 | eye_rel 中位 | 亮度中位 | 距离 dx 范围 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| open | 193 | 0.413 | 153 | 71~115 |
| closed | 208 | 0.414 | 148 | 89~108 |
| left | 196 | 0.412 | 147 | 87~108 |
| right | 186 | 0.411 | **161**（偏亮 8.9%） | 67~103 |
| other | 208 | — | 121 | 0~153 |

`right` 略亮，靠训练脚本里已有的 `ColorJitter(brightness=0.25)`（±25%）盖住，无需处理。

---

## 2. 训练

```bat
python train_blink.py --flat eye_photo --task blink --size 64x128 --epochs 60 --out models --batch 32 --lr 1e-3
```

和上次的命令**只差 `--epochs`**（上次默认 30，这次建议 60——样本数从 585 涨到 991，每轮看到的更多，但边界样本也更多，多跑几轮更稳）。

**如果显存/时间充裕**，可以试 `--epochs 100`；如果 val acc 在 40 轮后就不再涨，60 轮足够。

产物：`models/blink_best.pt`

---

## 3. 导出 ONNX

```bat
python export_onnx.py --pt models/blink_best.pt --out models/blink_v3.onnx --task blink --size 64x128
python verify_onnx.py models/blink_v3.onnx
```

`verify_onnx.py` 会打印输入输出形状，应该是：

```
IN  input  [1, 3, 64, 128]
OUT output [1, 5]
```

---

## 4. 验收标准（**重点看 left/right**）

跑完 `train_blink.py` 会打印混淆矩阵。**必须检查这三条**：

### ① 总体 val acc ≥ 0.95

### ② `left` / `right` 召回 ≥ 0.85 —— **这是本次重训的核心指标**

**背景**：上一版模型在 board 上新数据上 `left` 召回是 **0/196**、`right` 是 **0/186**（判成了 open）。三个可能原因按可能性排序：

1. **构图变了**：宽高比从 2.07 变成 2.76，resize 到 2.0 时横向压缩 38%，而 left/right 的判据正是眼角那块眼白楔形，形状被改得最狠
2. **旧模型没学过这种构图**
3. 数据本身的问题（已排除：头偏检查显示 left/right 没有系统性偏转，眼白楔形清晰可见）

本次用**同一构图**训练，模型应该能适应新的压缩比例。**如果 left/right 召回还是低于 0.85，说明问题不在构图，而是在数据本身** —— 那时再看混淆矩阵里 left 被判成了什么，告诉 Linux 端，需要补采。

### ③ `open → left` 误判要接近 0

**上一版最严重的问题**：遮挡实验发现，旧模型把"眼睛下方那块（脸颊+鼻孔）"当成了"这是 open"的证据，遮掉它 4/5 张就翻成 left。真实场景里稍微换个距离/光照，这个捷径就崩，left 冒出来。

新数据**已经把鼻孔裁出框了**，理论上这条捷径没有了。**请确认混淆矩阵里 `open→left` 那一格接近 0。**

---

## 5. 回传清单

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `models/blink_v3.onnx` | **必需**，量化用 |
| **训练日志全文** | **必需**，含混淆矩阵，要粘贴回给 Linux 端 |
| `models/blink_best.pt` | 可选，保险起见 |

**日志要包含**：`scan` 阶段的各类张数、每轮 loss/val acc、最后的混淆矩阵、`Best val acc`。

---

## 6. 之后（先不用做，等 Linux 端确认）

拿到 ONNX 后：

1. **量化**（`quantize_onnx.py`，calib-count 345）
2. **`stedgeai generate`** → `network.c` / `network_ecblobs.h` / `network_atonbuf.xSPI2.raw`
3. 回传三个产物

**注意**：上次尝试的 **QOperator 格式已被工具链明确拒绝**（`Unsupported layer types: QGemm`，ST Edge AI Core v2.0.0-20049），**不要再用**，直接走 QDQ。

---

## 7. 环境速查

如果 Windows 环境有问题（torch 缺失、CUDA 不对），先确认：

```bat
python -c "import torch; print(torch.__version__, torch.cuda.is_available())"
```

应该看到 torch 版本号 + `True`。4060 会显示为 `cuda:0`。

依赖（`requirements.txt` 里也有）：

```
torch
torchvision
onnx
onnxruntime
numpy
pillow
```

**首次运行 `train_blink.py` 会下载 MobileNetV2 的 ImageNet 预训练权重**（约 14 MB）。上次训过的话应该已缓存在 `C:\Users\<你>\.cache\torch\hub\checkpoints\`，不会重复下载。

"""Assemble the v3 dataset package for the Windows machine.

Self-contained on purpose: the scripts go in alongside the data so the
Windows side cannot end up running a stale copy of eye_common.py against a
new layout - the class order and the scan rules live there, and a mismatch
would silently relabel the training set.
"""
import hashlib
import os
import shutil

SRC = "/home/leihann/SoftwarePackage/eye_ai_train"
DST = ("/home/leihann/SoftwarePackage/"
       "交付包_眼动数据集v3_给Windows_2026-09-19")

DIRS = ("open", "close", "left", "right", "other")
SCRIPTS = ("train_blink.py", "eye_common.py", "export_onnx.py",
           "verify_onnx.py", "quantize_onnx.py", "requirements.txt",
           "一键训练.bat")
DOCS = ("/home/leihann/SoftwarePackage/训练任务书_v3_2026-09-19.md",)

if os.path.isdir(DST):
    shutil.rmtree(DST)
os.makedirs(DST)

total = 0
manifest = []

# ---- images ---------------------------------------------------------------
for d in DIRS:
    src = os.path.join(SRC, "eye_photo", d)
    if not os.path.isdir(src):
        print("  !! missing %s" % src)
        continue
    dst = os.path.join(DST, "eye_photo", d)
    os.makedirs(dst)
    n = 0
    for f in sorted(os.listdir(src)):
        if not f.lower().endswith(".bmp"):
            continue
        shutil.copy2(os.path.join(src, f), os.path.join(dst, f))
        manifest.append("eye_photo/%s/%s" % (d, f))
        n += 1
    total += n
    print("  %-8s %3d bmp" % (d, n))

# the per-directory meta the board wrote - kept for traceability
for d in DIRS:
    src = os.path.join(SRC, "eye_photo", d, "meta.txt")
    if os.path.exists(src):
        dst = os.path.join(DST, "eye_photo", d, "meta.txt")
        shutil.copy2(src, dst)
        manifest.append("eye_photo/%s/meta.txt" % d)

src = os.path.join(SRC, "eye_photo", "meta.txt")
if os.path.exists(src):
    shutil.copy2(src, os.path.join(DST, "eye_photo", "meta.txt"))
    manifest.append("eye_photo/meta.txt")

# ---- scripts and docs -----------------------------------------------------
for f in SCRIPTS:
    src = os.path.join(SRC, f)
    if os.path.exists(src):
        shutil.copy2(src, os.path.join(DST, f))
        manifest.append(f)
    else:
        print("  -- 跳过（不存在）: %s" % f)

for f in DOCS:
    if os.path.exists(f):
        shutil.copy2(f, os.path.join(DST, os.path.basename(f)))
        manifest.append(os.path.basename(f))

# ---- manifest with checksums ----------------------------------------------
lines = []
for rel in sorted(manifest):
    p = os.path.join(DST, rel)
    with open(p, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append("%s  %s" % (h, rel))

with open(os.path.join(DST, "CHECKSUMS.sha256"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")

size = sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(DST, r)) for r in manifest)
print()
print("  图像总数 %d" % total)
print("  文件总数 %d（含脚本/文档/校验）" % (len(manifest) + 1))
print("  总大小   %.1f MB" % (size / 1024.0 / 1024.0))
print("  输出     %s" % DST)

"""Bump the training epochs in the convenience .bat to match the task sheet.

Only the train_blink.py line - eval_model.py and export_onnx.py also take
--size 64x128 and must not be touched.  The file is CRLF, so a regex on the
line content rather than a line-anchored substitution.

     "交付包_眼动数据集v3_给Windows_2026-09-19/一键训练.bat")

s = open(P, encoding="utf-8", newline="").read()
print("修改前:")
for ln in s.split("\r\n"):
    if "train_blink.py" in ln:
        print("  " + ln)

new, n = re.subn(
    r"(python train_blink\.py --flat eye_photo --task blink --size 64x128)(\r?\n)",
    r"\1 --epochs 60\2",
    s)

"""Independent check of the v3 models against the original data.

The handover claims 991/991 for float and 990/991 for int8, with the single
failure at left_0180.bmp.  Both models and the source images are on this
machine, so reproduce the claim rather than take it on trust.

Preprocessing mirrors train_blink.py exactly: Resize((64,128)), which for a
PIL input delegates to PIL BILINEAR, then ToTensor (divide by 255) and
Normalize(0.5, 0.5).  Class order is closed, open, left, right, other - the
same order the board decodes.

Note the directory called "close" holds the class "closed"; the label comes
from the file prefix, but here the directory is the authority.
"""
import glob
import os

import numpy as np
import onnxruntime as ort
from PIL import Image

PKG = "/home/leihann/SoftwarePackage/交付包_眼动模型v3产物_给Linux_2026-09-19"
DATA = "/home/leihann/SoftwarePackage/eye_ai_train/eye_photo"
CLASSES = ["closed", "open", "left", "right", "other"]
DIRMAP = {"close": "closed", "open": "open", "left": "left",
          "right": "right", "other": "other"}

samples = []
for d, cls in DIRMAP.items():
    for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(DATA, d, "*.bmp"))):
        samples.append((f, CLASSES.index(cls)))

print("数据: %s" % DATA)
print("样本: %d 张" % len(samples))
print()


def prep(path):
    im = Image.open(path).convert("RGB").resize((128, 64), Image.BILINEAR)
    x = np.asarray(im, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
    x = (x - 0.5) / 0.5
    return np.transpose(x, (2, 0, 1))[None].astype(np.float32)


for name, fname in (("float32", "blink_v3.onnx"),
                    ("int8 QDQ", "blink_v3_qdq_int8.onnx")):
    path = os.path.join(PKG, "01_模型", fname)
    sess = ort.InferenceSession(path, providers=["CPUExecutionProvider"])
    cm = np.zeros((5, 5), dtype=int)
    wrong = []

    for img, true in samples:
        z = sess.run(None, {"input": prep(img)})[0][0]
        pred = int(z.argmax())
        cm[true][pred] += 1
        if pred != true:
            wrong.append((img, true, pred))

    acc = np.trace(cm) / cm.sum()
    print("══ %s (%s) ══" % (name, fname))
    print("  总准确率 = %.4f  (n=%d)" % (acc, cm.sum()))
    print("  %-8s %s" % ("", "  ".join("%8s" % c for c in CLASSES)))
    for i, c in enumerate(CLASSES):
        print("  %-8s %s   recall %.3f (n=%d)"
              % (c, "  ".join("%8d" % v for v in cm[i]),
                 cm[i][i] / cm[i].sum() if cm[i].sum() else 0, cm[i].sum()))
    if wrong:
        print("  误判 %d 张:" % len(wrong))
        for img, t, p in wrong:
            print("    %s  true=%s pred=%s"
                  % (os.path.basename(img), CLASSES[t], CLASSES[p]))
    else:
        print("  误判 0 张")
    print()

**两边日志都是真实的**——Windows 记录的是 1 张（left 0.995），我复现出 7 张（left 0.964）。同一模型同一数据，差异来自 onnxruntime 的 QDQ 实现版本。

这 7 张是关键：**是"难样本"还是"量化损失"？** 用 float 模型对照看它们的置信度：

input.content:
"""Are the 7 int8 failures hard samples, or quantization loss?

Run the same frames through both models and compare the softmax.  If float
is also unsure, the frames sit on the decision boundary and int8 merely tips
them - nothing to fix.  If float is confident and int8 is not, the loss is
in the quantization and the calibration is worth a second look.
"""
import glob
import os

import numpy as np
import onnxruntime as ort
from PIL import Image

PKG = "/home/leihann/SoftwarePackage/交付包_眼动模型v3产物_给Linux_2026-09-19"
LEFT = "/home/leihann/SoftwarePackage/eye_ai_train/eye_photo/left"
CL = ["closed", "open", "left", "right", "other"]

FOCUS = [117, 132, 150, 168, 174, 178, 180]
# a few that both models get right, for contrast
REF = [1, 2, 50, 100, 200]


def prep(p):
    im = Image.open(p).convert("RGB").resize((128, 64), Image.BILINEAR)
    x = np.asarray(im, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
    x = (x - 0.5) / 0.5
    return np.transpose(x, (2, 0, 1))[None].astype(np.float32)


def soft(z):
    e = np.exp(z - z.max())
    return e / e.sum()


sf = ort.InferenceSession(PKG + "/01_模型/blink_v3.onnx",
                          providers=["CPUExecutionProvider"])
si = ort.InferenceSession(PKG + "/01_模型/blink_v3_qdq_int8.onnx",
                          providers=["CPUExecutionProvider"])

print("int8 误判的 7 张：")
print("  样本    float 判决        int8 判决         left 概率 f/i")
for s in FOCUS:
    f = "%s/left_%04d.bmp" % (LEFT, s)
    if not os.path.exists(f):
        print("  %04d  缺失" % s)
        continue
    pf = soft(sf.run(None, {"input": prep(f)})[0][0])
    pi = soft(si.run(None, {"input": prep(f)})[0][0])
    print("  %04d   %-6s %.3f      %-6s %.3f      %.3f / %.3f"
          % (s, CL[pf.argmax()], pf.max(), CL[pi.argmax()], pi.max(),
             pf[2], pi[2]))

print()
print("对照（两个模型都判对的 5 张）：")
for s in REF:
    f = "%s/left_%04d.bmp" % (LEFT, s)
    if not os.path.exists(f):
        continue
    pf = soft(sf.run(None, {"input": prep(f)})[0][0])
    pi = soft(si.run(None, {"input": prep(f)})[0][0])
    print("  %04d   %-6s %.3f      %-6s %.3f      %.3f / %.3f"
          % (s, CL[pf.argmax()], pf.max(), CL[pi.argmax()], pi.max(),
             pf[2], pi[2]))

"""Pull the input/output quantisation parameters out of the v3 int8 model.

These four numbers have to reach the board.  eye_cam_main.c hard-codes the
input and output scale/zero-point and uses them to turn the camera pixels
into the tensor and the raw output back into logits; if they disagree with
what stedgeai was given, every inference is quietly wrong and nothing
reports an error.  Last round they were read off the generated network.c
after the fact - getting them from the ONNX up front makes the comparison a
check rather than the source of truth.
"""
import onnx
from onnx import numpy_helper

P = ("/home/leihann/SoftwarePackage/"
     "交付包_眼动模型v3产物_给Linux_2026-09-19/01_模型/blink_v3_qdq_int8.onnx")

m = onnx.load(P)
inits = {i.name: numpy_helper.to_array(i) for i in m.graph.initializer}


def dump(node, tag):
    print("%s  (%s)" % (tag, node.name))
    for nm in node.input[1:]:
        if nm in inits:
            print("    %-30s = %s" % (nm, inits[nm]))


for n in m.graph.node:
    if n.op_type == "QuantizeLinear" and n.input[0] == "input":
        dump(n, "输入 QuantizeLinear")
    if n.op_type == "DequantizeLinear" and n.output[0] == "output":
        dump(n, "输出 DequantizeLinear")

print()
